title: Codex Usage Dock
shortDescription: Track your Codex 5-hour and weekly subscription limits in the PowerToys Dock.
description:
See your Codex 5-hour and weekly usage at a glance. The ring gauges turn amber at 80% and red at 95%. Click a gauge to see when the limit resets and how recent the reading is.

Requires PowerToys with Command Palette and its Dock enabled, plus a local Codex installation that records subscription limits. After installing, reload Command Palette, right-click the Dock, choose Edit, and add Codex Usage Dock.

The extension reads usage data from local Codex session logs. It is an independent open-source project.
